## Goals


- Refresh knowledge of basic commands
- Use the terminal with our projects
- Disclaimer: I use macOS but some of this still works on Windows or Linux


## Terminology: Terminal vs. Shell vs. Command

- terminal: the application itself
- shell: the program that interprets and executes your commands (default for macs is zsh)
- command: what you type into the terminal


## Basic commands

- cd: change directory
- pwd: print working directory
- ls: list all files & folders
- mkdir: make a new directory
- touch: make a new file
- open: opens in Finder or your development environment
- rm: delete
- . : current directory
- .. : parent directory



## Make Positron a command in your terminal

- open Positron
- View -> Command Palette -> Search "install 'positron' command in PATH"
